title: 第十三章 能力检测
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陆云铮低头。

就见自己的面前摆着一个透明玻璃瓶，瓶内装着一滴幽蓝色的液体。

只是这么简单隔着玻璃瓶对望，陆云铮都能感受到从瓶子里面传来的浓浓生命力。

黎雾的声音在此时响起：

“陆警官，这就是刚刚成功抓捕张涛和王大强后，系统奖励的那滴治愈灵泉，你可以交给专业的机构检测一下，就能证明我说的到底是真的还是假的了。”

陆云铮意味不明的抬眼看了一眼黎雾。

审讯室他和黎雾中间隔着一段距离。

面前的玻璃瓶突然出现在他面前，这完全不符合常理的一件事，甚至不能让他用变魔术来进行解释。

陆云铮站起身：

“我先送你回学校。”

“等有消息了，我们再继续谈谈。”

黎雾点头应答，她知道陆云铮不会这么快相信自己的。

至少要检查一下这个所谓的治愈灵泉到底有什么效果再说。

半个小时后

黎雾的身影出现在高三（一）班。

整个班级都沸腾了起来。

裴真第一时间跑到黎雾身边：

“黎雾，没想到那居然真的是一具骷髅架，你视力也太好了。”

“之前你跟我说，我都没有相信，差点就让那两个人把骷髅架给运出去了。”

“幸好你果断直接报警。”

“现在整个学校都在讨论这件事。”

黎雾面色没有丝毫变化，转而问道：

“那这边现在有查到什么消息了吗？”

裴真摇摇头：

“这我们哪知道，校长和年级主任都去配合调查去了。”

“估计很快就会有结果了吧。”

“希望是这样。”黎雾吐了一口气。

云城研究所

陆云铮在第一时间把黎雾交给他的那滴治愈灵泉送去了研究所，以最快的速度检测。

当检查报告出来的瞬间，整个研究所的人都震惊了。

“陆队，不得了，不得了。”

“实在是太让人震惊了。”

“简直不像是这个世界所能存在的东西。”

“细胞高度活跃，高强度治愈性，充满生机，我们怀疑要是给病重垂危的人服下，说不定能瞬间治愈疾病。”

Page (1/3)

Lu Yunzheng lowered his head.

He saw a transparent glass bottle in front of him, containing a drop of blue liquid.

Just by looking at each other across the glass bottle, Lu Yunzheng could feel the strong vitality coming from inside the bottle.

Li Wu's voice sounded at this time:

"Officer Lu, this is the drop of the healing spring that the system rewarded after successfully arresting Zhang Tao and Wang Daqiang. You can give it to a professional institution for testing to prove whether what I said is true or false."

Lu Yunzheng raised his eyes and glanced at Li Wu with unknown meaning.

There was a distance between him and Li Wu in the interrogation room.

The glass bottle in front of him suddenly appeared in front of him. This was completely unreasonable and could not even be explained by magic.

Lu Yunzheng stood up:

"I'll take you back to school first."

"We will continue talking when there is news."

Li Wu nodded in response, knowing that Lu Yunzheng would not believe her so quickly.

At least we need to check what effect this so-called healing spring has.

half an hour later

Li Wu appeared in Class 1, Grade 3.

The whole class was excited.

Pei Zhen ran to Li Wu immediately:

"Li Wu, I didn't expect that it was actually a skeleton. Your eyesight is too good."

"When you told me before, I didn't even believe it. I almost asked those two people to transport the skeleton frame out."

"Fortunately, you decisively called the police directly."

"The whole school is talking about it now."

Li Wu's expression did not change at all, and he turned to ask:

"Have you found any news here now?"

Pei Zhen shook his head:

"How did we know this? The principal and grade director have gone to cooperate with the investigation."

"I guess there will be results soon."

"I hope so." Li Wu breathed out.

Yuncheng Research Institute

Lu Yunzheng immediately sent the drop of healing spring that Li Wu gave him to the research institute for testing as quickly as possible.

When the inspection report came out, everyone in the institute was shocked.

"Army, it's incredible, it's incredible."

"It's just so shocking."

"It's simply not like something that can exist in this world."

"The cells are highly active, highly healing, and full of vitality. We suspect that if given to seriously ill people, the disease may be cured instantly."
